description: Expected results for Ribasim's official test model 'basic' (python/ribasim_testmodels basic_model(), written by utils/generate-testmodels.py; Deltares/Ribasim commit fcfb329a, version 2026.1.0-rc2). 4 basins, 17 nodes, 17 links, 2020-01-01 to 2021-01-01, daily output, concentration tracking on. The four end_storage checks use the values and tolerance (atol = 1.5 m3) asserted in Ribasim's own Julia test core/test/run_models_test.jl, testitem 'basic model' (current_storage at end of run). The concentration checks follow the same test's asserts (Continuity == 1, sum of source fractions == 1, ResidenceTime > 0; Julia isapprox default rtol ~1.5e-8). The water-balance checks use Ribasim's own default solver limits (water_balance_abstol 1e-3, water_balance_reltol 1e-2). The rest are counts and totals recorded from our own run; two runs gave the same numbers.
engine_version: Ribasim 2026.1.0-rc2 (Julia core from github.com/Deltares/Ribasim commit fcfb329a, Julia 1.12.5)

numeric_checks.name: basin_n_times
numeric_checks.why: one saved state per day of 2020 (leap year)

numeric_checks.name: flow_n_links
numeric_checks.why: all 17 links in the model get a flow

numeric_checks.name: max_abs_balance_error
numeric_checks.why: Ribasim water balance closes within its own default water_balance_abstol (1e-3); our run gives ~1e-17

numeric_checks.name: max_abs_relative_error
numeric_checks.why: Ribasim water balance closes within its own default water_balance_reltol (1e-2); our run gives ~6e-14

numeric_checks.name: continuity_max_dev
numeric_checks.why: OFFICIAL assert: Continuity tracer stays 1.0 everywhere

numeric_checks.name: source_sum_max_dev
numeric_checks.why: OFFICIAL assert: source fractions (Initial, LevelBoundary, FlowBoundary, UserDemand, Drainage, Precipitation, SurfaceRunoff) sum to 1

numeric_checks.name: residence_time_min_positive
numeric_checks.why: OFFICIAL assert: all ResidenceTime values > 0 (1 = true)

numeric_checks.name: total_precipitation_m3
numeric_checks.why: own run: 4 basins x 366 days x 1 m3/day of precipitation

numeric_checks.name: total_evaporation_m3
numeric_checks.why: own run (repeated exactly in a second run); small tol for solver noise

numeric_checks.name: max_level_m
numeric_checks.why: own run: basin 9 level reaches the downstream level of 1.63 m

notes: basin.nc keeps storage at the start of each day, so end-of-run storage is computed as last storage + last storage_rate x 86400 s. Cross-check: this equals the storage from the final levels in basin_state.nc through the basin profile (e.g. basin 1: level 1.27523033 m -> 775.2353 m3). No input was changed for the run.
